problems.location: Exercise 1.2: Diagnosing deficit-based assumptions and stereotype threat vulnerability in organizational learning policies / block 4
problems.lesson_text: stereotype threat can significantly undermine learning outcomes for all students, especially those from marginalized groups, regardless of baseline motivation
